CA.name: Indian tobacco
CA.citation: United Plant Savers species profile; native range confirmed to include New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia

DE.name: Indianertabak
DE.citation: Species-specific name across many independent German retailers (Magic Garden Seeds, Dragonspice, ethnoplants.com, Pflueger); one source explicitly notes it is botanically unrelated to genus Nicotiana despite the name

FR.name: Tabac indien
FR.citation: French Wikipedia dedicated article "Tabac indien" for Lobelia inflata; cross-confirmed across independent French commercial sources (Alsagarden, ethnoplants.com)

GB.name: Indian tobacco
GB.citation: Standard English common name, consistently and unambiguously used (Britannica, PFAF, Plants For A Future); distinguished throughout sources from ornamental Lobelia erinus

JP.name: ロベリアソウ
JP.citation: National Museum of Nature and Science (Japan) specimen record; Nikko Botanical Garden field documentation. Species-specific, distinct from ルリミゾカクシ (Lobelia erinus, the ornamental species)
